accounting.budget: stake and K are reported outputs, never a rejection gate
accounting.folds_and_loyo: every output retains fold/year; any LOYO report holds each complete issue instance intact
accounting.participation: all frozen portfolios are retained; no overlap rejection
accounting.tax: Gate B will aggregate gross by issue_instance, variant, arm and apply the existing actual-tax rule without cross-issue aggregation

complete_issue_contract.candidate_competition: all complete-issue matches with p_min <= variant maximum sort by p_min, match_idx, match_id; deterministic top 32 are searched
complete_issue_contract.insufficient_issue_rule: <7 matches is an explicit NO_BET row
complete_issue_contract.n7_construction: candidate plus six highest E_SP eligible companions from the whole same issue instance; candidates and companions compete across the full issue
complete_issue_contract.primary_unit: (issue, fold) issue instance; no issue is segmented for selection or construction
complete_issue_contract.segment_metadata: source pool_id/segment_index is never read as a selection, availability, or construction constraint

deletion_rule: Within each matched seven-match portfolio, p_min selects argmin calibrated p and q_min selects argmin q=p*predicted_SP, with match_idx then code-order (3,1,0) tie breaks. The match set is identical across three arms.
legacy_boundary: results/bj132_gate_a_preoutcome_v1 and its settlement are immutable segment-compatible legacy comparators only; they are non-controlling sensitivity evidence.
outcome_boundary: No result, score, final SP, payout, tax realization, ROI, or settlement source is read or emitted. Gate B is NOT_RUN and NOT_AUTHORIZED pending PI acceptance of this exact replacement Gate A.
role_encoding: one seven-row role assignment per portfolio; the frontier's p/q deletion identities deterministically derive all three arms' allowed-code sets without arm-by-arm role duplication
scope: historical paper-only research; no purchase, production, or promotion.
